**Develop your rolls on your computer with Darkrooms.** The camera develops a roll slowly, at a smaller size. Darkrooms develops it on your computer from the full RAW, in the same colours the camera gives it.
Free: one roll a day (up to 36 frames), every film, full size. Darkrooms Full: unlimited rolls, US$14.99 once or US$2.99 a month.
Windows and Mac: https://github.com/HNGSeries/Darkrooms-app/releases/latest
